summary: The display's device pixel ratio and colour scheme, and the GPU's limits (WebGL2 support, largest texture).
rate: At start and whenever one changes (moving the window to another screen).

x-friction.gap: Pixel ratio, colour scheme and GPU limits are read by scattered media queries and renderer probes; a change doesn't re-demand anything.
x-friction.closes: Environment facts as sources whose changes re-demand what depends on them.
